name: api-tests
description: API tests for the Wikipedia APIs and Restful Booker: Postman collections run with Newman

scripts.test: npm run test:wikipedia-api && npm run test:restful-booker
scripts.test:wikipedia-api: mkdir -p reports && newman run postman/wikipedia-api.postman_collection.json -r cli,junit,htmlextra --reporter-junit-export reports/wikipedia-api.xml --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/wikipedia-api.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Wikipedia API"
scripts.test:restful-booker: mkdir -p reports && newman run postman/restful-booker.postman_collection.json -e postman/restful-booker.postman_environment.json -r cli,junit,htmlextra --reporter-junit-export reports/restful-booker.xml --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/restful-booker.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Restful Booker"
